description: This Java source file defines the CoreEvents class, which manages web application events related to the framework components of Apache OFBiz. It includes event handlers for scheduling services, running services, and file streaming within the OFBiz web application.

classes.name: CoreEvents
classes.description: This class provides static methods to handle core web application events such as scheduling services, executing services, returning success/error responses, and streaming files within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: returnSuccess
methods.description: Returns the string 'success', used as a placeholder response for successful events.

methods.name: returnError
methods.description: Returns the string 'error', used as a placeholder response for error events.

methods.name: returnNull
methods.description: Returns null, used as a placeholder for null response events.

methods.name: scheduleService
methods.description: Schedules a service to run at a specified time or recurrence pattern based on request parameters, including validation of inputs and permissions.

methods.name: saveServiceResultsToSession
methods.description: Stores the results of a synchronized service call into the user's session, optionally clearing previous saved results.

methods.name: getObjectFromServicePath
methods.description: Extracts nested objects from a service result map using a specified service path string.

methods.name: runService
methods.description: Runs a specified service either synchronously or asynchronously, with security and permission checks.

methods.name: streamFile
methods.description: Streams a file to the client browser based on the request's path info.
